title: Universal Search, Batch Assignment & Roster Accuracy Update (v0.4.15)
message: Includes real-time Bento search across library, materials, assignment picker, and performance rosters, Select All quick actions, homeroom learner counting fixes, and standalone DepEd Phil-IRI reading materials.
changelog:
• Universal Real-Time Search: Instant Bento squircle search bar across Teacher Library, Subject Materials, Assignment Picker, Class Roster, and Student Mastery Performance.
• Quick Batch Assignment: Added 'Select All' and 'Clear All' pill actions to the material access manager.
• Accurate Learner Metrics: Fixed adviser dashboard metric so homeroom students are properly counted alongside joined subject students.
• Zero-Latency Filtering: 100% in-memory filtering with 0ms delay and zero redundant database reads.
• Standalone Official Phil-IRI & DepEd Reading Treasury Assets integrated.
• Bug Fixes & Stability: Eliminated layout flicker and guaranteed crash-free execution.
